name: CASTDATE and DATE
desc: Covers CASTDATE and DATE: required ISO-style string forms, date-field objects and defaults, calendar and clock validation, timezone spellings, leap seconds, fractional-second truncation, virtual fields, precision distinctions, instant equality, and CASTSTR re-stringification. Dates remain expression values; portable expectations contain only JSON booleans, strings, and numbers. Re-stringification is checked for format and semantic round trips without prescribing host date objects or redundant fractional zeroes. Precision-sensitive cases permit UNSUPPORTED_GRAFT when the host cannot represent the value under its configured precision policy. Native Date ownership, mutation, host ranges, and configuration belong to implementation-specific tests.

tests.name: Calendar dates
tests.desc: Required date strings accept standard four-digit years and optional hyphens. Gregorian leap-year rules apply from 1583 onward; valid earlier dates also exercise year zero and the native Date 0–99 year trap.

tests.name: Datetimes and timezone spellings
tests.desc: T and space delimit date/time, time colons are optional, and timezone forms include Z and signed hours, hours/minutes, or compact hours/minutes. Unicode minus is valid for nonzero offsets.

tests.name: Field objects and defaults
tests.desc: year is required. month/day default to one; time fields default to zero once any is present, and tz_offset selects timestamp precision. Fields are numeric and presence, rather than truthiness, selects precision.

tests.name: Fractional seconds and leap seconds
tests.desc: Comma and period fractions are accepted. Millisecond-exact values retain their value; finer input may be truncated downward to the host resolution or rejected as unsupported. Leap seconds are preserved without checking historical occurrence.

tests.name: Calendar and clock rejection
tests.desc: Recognizable dates after the Gregorian cutoff must reject impossible calendar days rather than normalize them. Invalid clock fields and negative zero timezones are not valid ISO values.

tests.name: Invalid field objects and input types
tests.desc: Missing year, invalid numeric field types, noninteger calendar/minute fields, and out-of-range fields are invalid targets. Object fields are not interpreted through coercion methods.

tests.name: Date precision and instant equality
tests.desc: date, datetime, and timestamp are different match types. Timestamps with different minute offsets compare by logical instant, while leap seconds remain distinguishable from the next minute.

tests.name: Date is not a plain object
Date is not its string representation
Operand scope, storage, and errors
tests.desc: Explicit operands use value context, DATE is a probe without changing the current node, and date values retain their precision/offset while stored in const, stash, or TEMP. Syntax, resource, and configured host-precision errors remain fatal.

tests.name: Missing date field is a false probe
Wrong field path type is not an object coercion
DATE does not transform its source
DATE does not take a value operand
